nodes.norm_label: bupot 2026 unreadable amount logged gagal (excluded from recap)

nodes.label: Lean Engine (pandas and numpy dropped)
nodes.rationale: Dropping pandas/numpy makes the engine smaller and each run start faster; Excel output of all five extraction tools stays identical per cell.

nodes.label: Per-cell Excel Reference Comparison (contoh-pdf/acuan, --perbarui-acuan)
nodes.rationale: Every sample folder's Excel is compared per cell (values, number formats, styles, links, widths, freeze, filter) with a local reference so any engine change shifting one cell is visible; references are not committed because they hold real data and should only be regenerated from proven-correct code.

nodes.label: pandas/numpy Excluded From Nuitka Engine (--nofollow-import-to)
nodes.rationale: openpyxl and pypdfium2 import pandas/numpy only optionally, so they are not bundled even if installed in the venv.

nodes.label: Query: Impact of changing appId (package.json -> main.js -> NSIS installer)
nodes.rationale: electron-builder derives the installer GUID from appId (UUID v5) when nsis.guid is unset and stamps appId as shortcut AUMID; changing it installs side by side like the 2.x migration. userData and single-instance lock are unaffected.
nodes.norm_label: query: impact of changing appid (package.json -> main.js -> nsis installer)

nodes.label: Release 3.1.0 (2026-10-12, CIMB, BPBS rename, duplicate flag)
nodes.norm_label: release 3.1.0 (2026-10-12, cimb, bpbs rename, duplicate flag)

nodes.label: Pinned Installer Identity (build.nsis.guid + build.appId)
nodes.rationale: build.nsis.guid is the 3.x Uninstall registry key; a different GUID or appId installs side by side like the 2.x case. appId is also the taskbar AppUserModelID and must equal APP_ID in app/main.js.

nodes.label: Query: Why build:renderer is the strongest graph bridge (release build, deps, changelog)
nodes.rationale: High betweenness is partly an artifact of missing package.json-to-code edges, but build:renderer really is a single point: start, test and release build all depend on it.
nodes.norm_label: query: why build:renderer is the strongest graph bridge (release build, deps, changelog)
